visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three people, one man and two women, are seated around a white circular table in a warm, wood-paneled indoor setting. They are performing a rhythmic game, passing a wooden tray and a handheld vacuum cleaner back and forth. The woman on the right wears a white oversized t-shirt, the man in the middle wears a cream short-sleeved button-down, and the woman on the left wears a brown spaghetti-strap dress. (2) The camera alternates between a group shot and closer angles of the participants. The participants exhibit high-energy facial expressions, wide smiles, and laughter. They clap their hands and move their arms in sync with a rhythmic pattern. (3) A brief digital static/glitch effect is applied to the frame as a transition. (4) The woman in the brown dress is now standing in a bright cafe environment with shelving units behind her. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands. She is wearing a white tank top and blue jeans. (5) The camera cuts to close-up shots of various crystals, geodes, and decorative items displayed on wooden shelves under soft track lighting. (6) The woman continues her presentation in the cafe, walking through the space and pointing out various features like the seating area and crystal displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced hand-clapping and table-thumping percussion establish a strong rhythmic foundation. Three voices (one male, two female) engage in a call-and-response Mandarin dialogue in time with the beat. The vocal pitch is high, and the tone is energetic and playful. (2) Sudden laughter from the participants breaks the vocal rhythm momentarily. A mechanical clicking sound is heard as objects are moved. (3) A brief digital glitch sound effect interrupts the acoustic music bed. (4) The audio transitions to a bright acoustic pop track with a strummed guitar. A single female voice provides a clear, articulated narration with a friendly and inviting professional tone, listing specific address details and shop features. (5) Subtle ambient indoor cafe noise is present under the clear narration. (6) The video ends with a high-pitched, enthusiastic vocal exclamation from the primary female narrator.
